summary: Default auth login uses tesla_auth (not dead void-callback), signing keys must be regular-file ECDSA P-256 PEM (RSA/P-384/P-521 rejected), ALL candidates (including sole key) must match domain public key when verifiable — never auto-select an unrelated key, compactFields strips cached_data/tokens/backseat_token, error strings use clone+build (not @latest), docs lead with working flows.
reason: Tesla's OAuth rejects void-callback redirect_uri (404). fleet-register never persisted PrivateKeyPath and accepted directories/sockets/invalid/RSA/non-P-256 paths, causing silent failures later. Key resolvers picked arbitrary first-match by filename even when only one key existed, selecting an unrelated BLE/manual key when the sole candidate didn't match the registered public key. Error strings told users 'go install @latest' which fails due to upstream replace directives. Products --agent dumped huge cached_data protobuf. locateRelayPrivateKey hardcoded a personal car name. Docs taught the dead paste flow and used personal car names.
validated_outcome: Module build/vet/test pass (320+ cli tests). Default auth login uses tesla_auth or errors with install instructions. All key resolvers validate paths are regular files containing ECDSA P-256 PEM private keys (directories, sockets, unreadable files, RSA, P-384, P-521 rejected). Identity matching applies to ALL candidates including sole key: a single unrelated key with verifiable domain public key is rejected with clear error. Tests cover: directory rejected, unreadable rejected, RSA rejected, P-384/P-521 rejected, sole-candidate mismatch rejected, sole-candidate match accepted. Error strings give clone+build instructions. compactFields strips cached_data/tokens/backseat_token. Docs use generic <name>/<VIN> placeholders.
